summary: Diff adds a migration module for a new `blogViewCounts` map and wires migration into `backend/main.mo`, but the provided `backend/main.mo` snippet is truncated before any view-count storage, APIs, random initialization, or delete-hook behavior is visible. Based on available evidence, key backend requirements for initializing, reading, incrementing, listing, and lifecycle-cleanup of view counts are not demonstrated in the diff summary.

missing_requirements.requirement: Persist a per-blog view count in the backend so that every blog post (existing and future) has an initial randomly assigned view count between 700 and 1000 (inclusive), and the value can be read by any caller (publicly visible).
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows only a migration wrapper that copies an existing `blogViewCounts` map; it does not show any persisted storage being created/maintained in `main.mo`, any random initialization in the [700,1000] range, nor any publicly readable query method for counts.

missing_requirements.requirement: Implement backend APIs to (1) get a single blog's view count, (2) increment a blog's view count by exactly 1 when the blog is opened, and (3) fetch all view counts keyed by blog ID for list rendering.
missing_requirements.reason: No evidence in the visible `backend/main.mo` diff of methods `getBlogViewCount(blogId)`, `incrementBlogViewCount(blogId)`, or `getAllBlogViewCounts()`; the shown portion only includes access control, user profiles, and file registry APIs.

missing_requirements.requirement: Ensure existing blog posts receive an initial random view count between 700 and 1000 (inclusive) and continue incrementing by +1 per open thereafter.
missing_requirements.reason: Migration code only maps/copies `old.blogViewCounts` values; it does not initialize missing counts for existing blogs, and no initialization logic is shown in `main.mo` for post-upgrade or runtime creation of missing counts.

missing_requirements.requirement: Keep view-count storage consistent with blog lifecycle: when a blog post is deleted, its stored view count entry must also be removed so it no longer appears in the "all view counts" result.
missing_requirements.reason: No evidence shown that blog deletion logic removes the corresponding entry from `blogViewCounts`, and `getAllBlogViewCounts()` is not shown.

missing_requirements.requirement: Update backend stable state and upgrade behavior to safely introduce persisted blog view counts in the existing single-actor canister, including an upgrade/migration path that preserves existing data (blog posts, users, etc.).
missing_requirements.reason: A migration module is added and `main.mo` is wrapped with `(with migration = Migration.run)`, but the migration only passes through `blogViewCounts` and does not demonstrate preservation/migration of the rest of the canister state or initialization of missing view counts after upgrade.

hallucinated_features.description: Project metadata summary claims a new blog view count feature is implemented (random 700–1000, persisted, increments on open, public visibility) without corresponding visible backend implementation in the diff summary.
hallucinated_features.reason: `project_state.json` describes functionality, but the only concrete code added is a migration map copy; required backend APIs and initialization logic are not evidenced in the shown `main.mo` content.
